name: CourtListener
tagline: Free bulk + REST access to US case law, dockets, and RECAP PACER data
description: CourtListener (Free Law Project) provides the largest free REST and bulk access to US federal and state case law, court dockets, opinions, and RECAP PACER filings. Developers can search and retrieve legal documents, citations, oral arguments, and related metadata for research, compliance, and legal-tech applications.

auth.details: Token authentication via Authorization: Token YOUR_API_KEY header; free account required to obtain a token from the profile page

pricing.free_tier_limits: Free for non-commercial use with rate limits; commercial use requires paid plan or special agreement
pricing.paid_plans: Contact Free Law Project for commercial licensing

rate_limits: Varies by endpoint and account; authenticated users get higher limits than anonymous
use_cases: search US federal and state court opinions by keyword
look up a docket by case number or court
retrieve RECAP PACER documents and filings
get citation network and related cases for an opinion
bulk export case law for legal research pipelines
